# duplocloud_k8s_http_route (Resource)

`duplocloud_k8s_http_route` manages a Kubernetes HTTPRoute (gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1) in a Duplo tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "duplocloud_tenant" "myapp" {
  account_name = "myapp"
  plan_id      = "default"
}

resource "duplocloud_k8s_gateway" "gateway" {
  tenant_id = duplocloud_tenant.myapp.tenant_id
  name      = "my-gateway"
  is_public = false

  listener {
    name     = "http"
    port     = 80
    protocol = "HTTP"
  }
}

// Example 1: Route all traffic for a hostname to a single backend service.
resource "duplocloud_k8s_http_route" "basic" {
  tenant_id = duplocloud_tenant.myapp.tenant_id
  name      = "basic-route"

  parent_ref {
    name = duplocloud_k8s_gateway.gateway.name
  }

  hostnames = ["app.example.com"]

  rule {
    match {
      path {
        type  = "PathPrefix"
        value = "/"
      }
    }
    backend_ref {
      name = "my-service"
      port = 8080
    }
  }
}

// Example 2: Path-based routing with weighted backends and a redirect filter.
resource "duplocloud_k8s_http_route" "advanced" {
  tenant_id = duplocloud_tenant.myapp.tenant_id
  name      = "advanced-route"

  parent_ref {
    name         = duplocloud_k8s_gateway.gateway.name
    section_name = "http"
  }

  rule {
    match {
      path {
        type  = "PathPrefix"
        value = "/api"
      }
    }
    backend_ref {
      name   = "api-v1"
      port   = 8080
      weight = 90
    }
    backend_ref {
      name   = "api-v2"
      port   = 8080
      weight = 10
    }
  }

  rule {
    match {
      path {
        type  = "PathPrefix"
        value = "/old"
      }
    }
    backend_ref {
      name = "my-service"
      port = 8080
    }
    filters = jsonencode([
      {
        type = "RequestRedirect"
        requestRedirect = {
          path = {
            type               = "ReplacePrefixMatch"
            replacePrefixMatch = "/new"
          }
          statusCode = 301
        }
      }
    ])
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the HTTPRoute.
- `parent_ref` (Block List, Min: 1) The Gateways this HTTPRoute attaches to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--parent_ref))
- `rule` (Block List, Min: 1) The routing rules for the HTTPRoute. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))
- `tenant_id` (String) The GUID of the tenant that the HTTPRoute will be created in.

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) An unstructured key value map stored with the HTTPRoute that may be used to store arbitrary metadata. Annotations added by the backend or the gateway controller are ignored and left in place.
- `hostnames` (List of String) The hostnames used to match against the HTTP Host header.
- `labels` (Map of String) Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) the HTTPRoute.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--parent_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parent_ref`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the Gateway.

Optional:

- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the Gateway. Cross-namespace routing requires administrator privileges.
- `port` (Number) The port of the listener on the Gateway to attach to.
- `section_name` (String) The name of the listener on the Gateway to attach to.


<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `backend_ref` (Block List, Min: 1) The backend services traffic should be sent to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule--backend_ref))

Optional:

- `filters` (String) A JSON encoded list of HTTPRouteFilter objects (redirect, rewrite, header modification, etc). You can use the `jsonencode()` function to build this from JSON.
- `match` (Block List) Conditions for matching incoming requests against this rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule--match))

<a id="nestedblock--rule--backend_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.backend_ref`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the backend Kubernetes service.
- `port` (Number) The port of the backend Kubernetes service.

Optional:

- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the backend service. When different from the HTTPRoute's namespace, Duplo auto-creates a ReferenceGrant in the target namespace.
- `weight` (Number) The proportion of traffic forwarded to this backend, relative to other backends in this rule. Defaults to `1`.


<a id="nestedblock--rule--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.match`

Optional:

- `header` (Block List) HTTP request header matching conditions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule--match--header))
- `method` (String) The HTTP method to match against (e.g. `GET`, `POST`).
- `path` (Block List, Max: 1) Path matching condition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule--match--path))

<a id="nestedblock--rule--match--header"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.match.header`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the HTTP header to match against.
- `value` (String) The value of the HTTP header to match against.

Optional:

- `type` (String) The type of the header match.


<a id="nestedblock--rule--match--path"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.match.path`

Required:

- `value` (String) The value of the path to match against.

Optional:

- `type` (String) The type of the path match. Must be one of: `Exact`, `PathPrefix`, `RegularExpression`. Defaults to `PathPrefix`.




<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `update` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Example: Importing an existing kubernetes HTTPRoute
#  - *TENANT_ID* is the tenant GUID
#  - *NAME* is the HTTPRoute name
#
terraform import duplocloud_k8s_http_route.myroute v3/subscriptions/*TENANT_ID*/k8s/httproute/*NAME*
```
